gates.description: Consumer inventory complete: every caller of the facade identified with an owner (FU-10, gateway and VPN flow logs)

Every consumer has an IdP client registration with pas.policy.read and an entitlement (SEC-01) and calls the new API; before the first consumer is routed in an environment, PAS_INQUIRY_TIMESTAMP_ZONE is set there to the facade JVM time zone (FU-524-2)
Facade traffic is zero for 30 consecutive days at the gateway (PLT-01) while pas_inquiry_requests_total shows every consumer client on the new API

compat-api gate repointed at pas-policy-service (pas/scripts/api-contract.sh) and the authentication status changes approved in compat/allowed-changes.json; lastUpdated epoch millis compared value for value against facade responses in every environment (the gate only type-checks it, FU-524-2)
Sign-offs: Security, Product Owner, facade owner, downstream consumers, ARB
Rollback window closed: facade deployment scaled to zero for one full release cycle without a rollback request

steps.description: Scale the facade deployment to zero and remove its gateway route (environment change, outside this repository)
Repoint make compat-api at the new service and drop the JDK 8 requirement from compat/README.md and compat-gate.yml
Remove facade references from README.md and docs/modernization (inventory regenerated with make inventory)
Open a PR with the deletion; never push it to a protected branch directly
